About Me

The Person Behind the Work

I'm Blessing Brenda, an Executive Virtual Assistant based in Enugu State, Nigeria, with over 4 years of experience supporting business owners and executives across administrative operations, communications, and workflow management.

My background spans both personal assistance in a fast-paced bakery environment and secretarial work in a corporate setting, giving me a well-rounded understanding of what it takes to keep a business running smoothly behind the scenes. I'm known for being reliable, discreet, and genuinely invested in the success of the people I work with.

I hold a B.Sc. in Industrial Chemistry from Ebonyi State University, a Cloud Computing Certificate, and I'm currently expanding my skill set with training in Software Development and UI/UX design, because I believe the best VAs keep evolving.

Based in Enugu State, Nigeria — available remotely worldwide
Specialises in executive support, calendar & inbox management, task coordination
Tools Google Workspace, Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Calendly
Available for remote roles, long-term contracts, and project-based work

Task Management

Client Project Tracker

Built a Trello board to manage an executive's daily and weekly tasks across four workflow stages, To Do, Doing, Done, and On Hold. Cards covered inbox setup, booking flights, preparing meeting agendas, scheduling weekly team meetings, researching travel accommodation, updating client contact databases, and preparing daily executive reports. Colour labels distinguished urgency and priority at a glance.

Tools Used

TrelloTask CoordinationWorkflow DesignProject Management

Outcome: Streamlined visibility across the full task pipeline, reducing missed deadlines and giving the executive a clear daily overview without micromanaging.

Email Management

Inbox Organisation System

Set up a fully labelled Gmail inbox with six custom categories: Action Required, Calendar & Scheduling, Clients – Active, Completed Tasks, Notes, and Pending (Waiting for Reply). Applied colour-coded labels, smart filters, and priority flags to automate triage. Implemented an end-of-day review habit to maintain zero unread emails and ensure every urgent message received a same-day response.

Tools Used

GmailLabel SystemEmail TriageFilter RulesGoogle Workspace

Outcome: Reduced email response time by 40% and ensured no urgent email was missed, giving the executive full confidence in their inbox management.

Calendar Management

Executive Weekly Calendar

Designed and managed a full week's executive schedule in Google Calendar for May 2026. Covered investor calls, client onboarding, mentorship sessions, team standups, partnership meetings, product development sessions, focus time blocks, lunch breaks, email review slots, and end-of-week reports. Events were colour-coded by category: red for meetings, green for focus/content, yellow for breaks, blue for wrap-ups.

Tools Used

Google CalendarSchedulingTime BlockingCalendlyAppointment Setting

Outcome: Eliminated scheduling conflicts and protected focus time, freeing the executive's mental bandwidth for high-priority decisions and client relationships.

Data Management

Client Contact Database

Created a colour-coded Google Sheets client database tracking 10 clients across TechStart Inc, Growfast Ltd, BlueSky Co, NextGen Ltd, StartUp Hub, GrowMore Inc, TechWave, AfriTech, LagosBiz, and RemoteFirst. Columns tracked client name, company, email, phone, status (Active / Pending / Inactive), and follow-up notes, with conditional formatting to flag clients needing attention.

Tools Used

Google SheetsData EntryCRM ManagementConditional Formatting

Outcome: Enabled instant client lookups and proactive re-engagement of inactive clients, improving overall client retention visibility for the executive.

Documentation

Email Management SOP

Authored a complete Email Management Standard Operating Procedure covering four daily steps: Morning Review (8am), scan inbox, delete spam, flag urgent items. Categorise Emails, label as Urgent / Follow Up / FYI / Waiting, forward to team. Respond to Emails, reply to urgent within 2 hours, professional language, CC executive where needed. End of Day Review (5pm), achieve zero unread, flag pending items, send daily email summary to executive.

Tools Used

Google DocsGmailTrello / NotionGoogle CalendarSOP Writing

Outcome: A reusable SOP that saves the executive 2–3 hours daily and ensures inbox excellence is maintained consistently by any VA following the system.
